hooks.prompt: OCXP code intelligence tools are available via MCP. When exploring or analyzing code, prefer OCXP tools over manual file reading -- they provide semantic understanding of the codebase graph. Start with ocxp_warmup for instant codebase orientation before using other OCXP tools. Key tools: ocxp_route (task navigation), ocxp_search (semantic search), ocxp_analyze (code quality), ocxp_plan (implementation planning).
